target_customer: Startups and tech companies' analysts needing a data modelling layer (subscription from $500/month)
problem: Building analytics requires hundreds of star-schema transformations; Narrator's Activity Schema models data in one table of customer activities.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription plus early consulting

founders.name: Ahmed Elsamadisi
founders.background_notes: Began career in self-driving cars and AI for missile defense; Forbes 30 Under 30 2019 (YC page).

technical_complexity.rationale: Data modelling standard and generated SQL on customer warehouses; conceptually novel but standard engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Value depends on customers adopting a new schema standard; the open Activity Schema spec can be used without Narrator.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found of incumbents copying the Activity Schema; the cause of the shutdown is not public.

market_need_then: TechCrunch (2019-08): 14 clients on the same data model at the time of the YC profile; startups lacking data teams.

branding.domain_note: Used narrator.ai per TechCrunch 2019; later no website listed on YC page

identity.voice_and_tone: Story-style analyses are a product feature; voice not described

branding.brand_signature: Activity Schema data standard (product asset, authored by founder)

brand_strength.rationale: Name fits the story-style analyses but sources show no brand-driven growth.

outcome_analysis: Narrator raised a $1.3M seed and a $6.2M Series A in 2020 for its Activity Schema approach, and was marked Inactive in the YC directory. The cause and date of shutdown are not public, so no failure factor is assigned; the founder is now working on AI agent systems. Competitors named by TechCrunch in Sep 2020, after the batch, were dbt, Looker's LookML, Airflow, Chartio Visual SQL and Tableau Prep.
notes: Outcome searches (shutdown, acquired, wind down) found nothing; cause and date of the shutdown are not public; exit.type taken from directory Inactive. Seed date is before YC (pre-batch) but TechCrunch gives no month. Aggregator disagreement: CB Insights dates Series A Oct 2019 and totals $7.65M; Bouncewatch totals $13.6M; TechCrunch dates it Sep 2020 and was used. No competitors dated near the batch were found (the 2019 article named none); the Sep 2020 list is in outcome_analysis. Name origin not found.
